# A17-S03: Project start

Correspondence extract. [████] marks redaction; […] marks omission.

[…]

Thank you for your reply and update, it was nice.

I have started on the party description and data collection for Julina, as I consider that these tasks should not be postponed regarding the project's feasibility. But I am waiting to publish, send daily content to [████], social media, funding applications and contact with artists regarding events. For all that, I need to be able to confirm that I work as artistic researcher in residence for MindFuture Foundation. Hence the itchy fingers ;-)

[████] So I had to figure out which tasks I need to take on now, and which can wait until contract signing.

Hope they can come up with something tomorrow :-)
